shots.name: 1-board
shots.caption: Tap an arrow to set it free
shots.text: An arrow slides off the board when nothing is in its way. Clear every arrow to win, and mind your hearts: a blocked tap costs one.
shots.alt: Level 33 in the Jungle: a zigzag board packed with bendy arrows, with a tap marker on the arrow that leaves first

shots.name: 2-map
shots.caption: Explore 17 colorful worlds
shots.text: One level map runs from the Meadow to Starlight, through jungle, lava, ice, candy and more. Daily puzzles, rankings and friends wait at the top.
shots.alt: The level map in Candy land at level 385, with the Daily, Ranking, Friends and Maps buttons

shots.name: 3-mirrors
shots.caption: Mirrors bend an arrow's path
shots.text: An arrow that meets a mirror turns by 90 degrees and keeps going. Plan the bounce before you tap.
shots.alt: Level 61 in the Volcano: glass mirrors among the arrows on a dark lava board

shots.name: 4-portals
shots.caption: Portals carry arrows across
shots.text: In one portal, out of its pair, anywhere on the board. This giant board mixes them with mirrors, rocks and bomb arrows.
shots.alt: Level 108 in the Lagoon: a pair of portals among mirrors, rocks and bomb arrows on a giant board

shots.name: 5-shutters
shots.caption: Shutters open as you clear arrows
shots.text: A steel roller door hides the arrows under it, even from powerups. Clear enough arrows and it rolls up.
shots.alt: Level 221 in the Crystal caves: a steel shutter on a diamond-shaped board

shots.name: 6-chain
shots.caption: Chain bombs blast whole walls
shots.text: Rocks side by side make a wall, and one chain bomb clears all of it. Free the bomb's path first.
shots.alt: Level 281 in Clockwork town: a wall of five rocks and its chain bomb

shots.name: 7-paint
shots.caption: Paint tiles recolor arrows
shots.text: An arrow that flies over a paint tile takes its color, ready for the color gate further along.
shots.alt: Level 191 in the Autumn woods: paint tiles on a ring-shaped board

shots.name: 8-switches
shots.caption: Keys open color doors
shots.text: The first arrow that flies over a key turns it, and every door of its color swings open at once.
shots.alt: Level 311 in Clockwork town: a yellow key and the locked door it opens on a heart-shaped board
